Multiple Fatalities and Injuries in Separate Vehicle Crashes

Two separate multi-vehicle crashes have resulted in fatalities and injuries. In Vaughan, Ontario, Canada, a two-vehicle collision occurred around 7:40 p.m. near Jane Street and Brandon Gate Drive, resulting in one death and two injuries. Separately, south of Adelaide, Australia, a two-vehicle collision in Moana led to the death of a girl and hospitalisation of two other individuals.
